title: Quadrilocular
summary: QUADRILOC'ULAR, adjective [Latin quadra, quatuor, and loculus, a cell.] Having four cells; four-celled; as a quadrilocular pericarp.

inlines.v: QUADRILOC'ULAR, adjective [Latin quadra, quatuor, and loculus, a cell.] Having four cells; four-celled; as a quadrilocular pericarp.
